notes: Diagnostic cross-cycle prediction reuses discovery data; not a calibrated significance or period uncertainty.
A quadratic and gap offsets may attenuate long signals; no samples were removed as flux outliers.
Integer aliases through order 8 share a family; this does not identify a physical mode.
Conditional residual checks require >=5% of original weighted variance; weaker real modes can be missed.
Sparse eclipses can use leave-one-cycle-out coverage with at least three predictive cycles.

warnings: Screening peak only; no correlated-noise false-alarm calibration or physical classification.

bls.note: Auxiliary box-shaped signal search on binned data; limited duration grid, no false-alarm calibration or classification.
